title: Add __riscv macro detection to support the scalar backend for RISCV
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

I'm researching running PyTorch on RISCV arch, and I found that by append !defined(__riscv) to !defined(s390x ) && !defined(powerpc) in aten/src/ATen/cpu/Utils.cpp, PyTorch can run on RISCV using the scalar CPU backend
